The code H4284 is the thought as intention or plan (nineteen verses), of man, of God, of the wicked and of the righteous; H7476 is the king's or Daniel's thoughts that come in the night and alarm (six verses of Daniel); H7454 and H8312 are the thoughts known to God and the anxious ones searched by him (Psa 139); H5587B is the disquiet that presses the speaker to answer (Job 20:2); H4209 is the proud man's device that leaves out God (Psa 10:4); H4093 is the secret thought (Ecc 10:20); H1902H is the muttering of the enemies (Lam 3:62); H1697I is what comes to mind before a scheme (Eze 38:10). In Greek G1261 is the reasonings of the heart that come out as evil or that Jesus knows (Mat 15:19, Mar 7:21, Luk 2:35, 5:22, 6:8, 1Cor 3:20, Jam 2:4), G1761 the thoughts known to Jesus or discerned by the word (Mat 9:4, 12:25, Heb 4:12), G1270 the thoughts Jesus knows (Luk 11:17), G1271 the thinking of the proud (Luk 1:51), G3540 the thinking that may be led astray (2Cor 11:3) and G3588 the article that carries the thoughts of a person (1Cor 2:11). So the surface is one word for many senses of the mind's holding or producing: plan, alarm, secret, device and reasoning.
